name: POST to Wasos chat
info:
Posts a bridged entry to the WaSOS chat API.

### Input
`msg.payload` = WaSOS POST body, `msg.metadata.target` = WaSOS Client

### Logic
Sets `x-api-key` header, URL `/api/chat/messages/{chatroom_name}`, sends POST. 500ms delay between requests.

### Output
`msg.topic = "response"`, `msg.result = true/false`, `msg.statusCode`

name: POST Chat Message To Wasos
info: Sends the message to WaSOS chat API with POST request. This is the step that delivers the Rayvn message into the WaSOS chat.

name: Format header and url
info: Builds HTTP request headers and URL for WaSOS API. Sets x-api-key header from wasos_apikey and uses wasosChatroomUrl as the endpoint. Returns null if not configured.
